blocks.text: Simon Fraser University Area Houses: the housing stock

items.t: The mountaintop's homes are strata apartments and townhomes at UniverCity, not a detached-house subdivision: the newest product named in developer materials is Arbour at SFU, 178 homes in 4 buildings of 1, 2 and 3 bedroom condominiums and 3 bedroom stacked townhomes in the Slopes neighbourhood.

blocks.text: Simon Fraser University Area Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The Burnaby Mountain Conservation Area rings the campus and community, so the mountaintop's open space is a conservation area with trails from about 25 metres to the 366-metre summit rather than a set of neighbourhood parks.
Arbour at SFU sits beside a new roughly 30,000-square-foot Slopes Neighbourhood Park in UniverCity's Slopes neighbourhood.

blocks.text: Simon Fraser University Area Houses: getting around

items.t: Burnaby Mountain Parkway and Gaglardi Way are the two roads up the mountain to the campus and UniverCity.

The proposed Burnaby Mountain Gondola would run from Production Way–University Station to a terminal near the SFU bus exchange, which is the station the mountain's transit plan is built around; the gondola is not approved or funded.

blocks.text: Simon Fraser University Area Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Treat a UniverCity purchase as a strata purchase: read the strata documents, bylaws and fee schedule, because the mountaintop stock is strata product rather than detached houses.
Do not price in the Burnaby Mountain Gondola: TransLink carries it as a proposal requiring a future investment plan plus TransLink Board and Mayors' Council approval.

blocks.text: Jared's take on Simon Fraser University Area

The SFU area is a mountaintop university village. UniverCity’s townhomes and small condos sit at 366 metres beside campus, with High Street as the main street, and it draws students, staff and anyone who wants the campus and Burnaby Mountain trails at the door.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Simon Fraser University Area?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 6 houses listed in Simon Fraser University Area. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Simon Fraser University Area a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Simon Fraser University Area had a sales ratio of not published for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Simon Fraser University Area from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 1 houses sold in Simon Fraser University Area over those 5 months, out of 251 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Simon Fraser University Area?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: How many people live at UniverCity?
faq.a: Over 5,000 residents, per the community's own site, in the neighbourhoods south and east of the SFU Burnaby campus on the mountaintop.

faq.q: Is there an elementary school on the mountain?
faq.a: Yes: University Highlands Elementary is the School District No.

faq.q: What did houses in Simon Fraser University SFU sell for?
faq.a: 7 houses sold in Simon Fraser University SFU between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,970,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Simon Fraser University SFU?
faq.a: The median was 29 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 93.9% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
